"""Execute the fresh thermal inversion and native one-phase-bit design example."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import torch

from examples.synthesis.applications.cfd.qls_for_hybrid_solvers.qls_qsvt.overview.phases import (
    response,
)

from . import model
from .workflow import BINDINGS, Result, run


def print_report(result: Result) -> None:
    print("Physical nodes and configurations:", 4, model.CONFIGURATIONS)
    print("Thermal normalization:", model.alpha())
    print(
        "Encoded and conditional block errors:",
        result.matrix_error,
        result.conditional_error,
    )
    print("Signed classical temperatures:", result.reference.tolist())
    print("Signed QSVT temperatures:", result.computed.tolist())
    print(
        "Spectral amplitude error and relative thermal error:",
        result.inverse_error,
        result.relative_error,
    )
    print("Inverse phase count:", result.reciprocal.fit.phases.numel())
    print("Mock bindings:", BINDINGS)
    print("Mock full-state errors:", result.mock_errors)
    print(
        "Mock probability masses:", tuple(result.mock_probabilities.sum(dim=1).tolist())
    )
    print(
        "Inverse, conditional and mock circuit widths:",
        result.inverse_resources.n_qubits,
        result.conditional_resources.n_qubits,
        result.mock_resources.n_qubits,
    )


def save_figures(result: Result, directory: Path) -> None:
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    figure, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.2), layout="constrained")
    x = torch.linspace(result.demo_reciprocal.minimum, 1, 1000, dtype=model.REAL)
    approximation = response(x, result.demo_reciprocal.fit.phases)
    axes[0].plot(x.tolist(), (0.3 / x).tolist(), "--", label="Scaled reciprocal")
    axes[0].plot(x.tolist(), approximation.tolist(), label="Fresh degree-11 response")
    axes[0].set(
        xlabel="Encoded value", ylabel="Response", title="Reciprocal demonstration"
    )
    axes[0].legend()
    nodes = torch.arange(1, 5, dtype=model.REAL)
    axes[1].bar(
        (nodes - 0.18).tolist(),
        result.reference.tolist(),
        width=0.35,
        label="Classical solve",
    )
    axes[1].bar(
        (nodes + 0.18).tolist(), result.computed.tolist(), width=0.35, label="QSVT"
    )
    axes[1].set(
        xlabel="Thermal node",
        ylabel="Temperature offset (K)",
        title="Four-node thermal solution",
    )
    axes[1].set_xticks(range(1, 5))
    axes[1].legend()
    figure.savefig(directory / "thermal-inverse.png", dpi=140)
    plt.close(figure)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--figures", type=Path, default=Path("cooling-figures"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    result = run()
    print_report(result)
    save_figures(result, args.figures)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Validate every conditional thermal branch and the complete mock QAE layer."""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

import flagquantum as fq
from examples.synthesis.applications.cfd.qls_for_hybrid_solvers.qls_qsvt.overview.phases import (
    response,
)
from flagquantum.compiler import ResourceEstimate, estimate_resources

from . import model, quantum

BINDINGS = ((0.67, 0.31), (-0.41, 0.23))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Result:
    matrix: torch.Tensor
    reference: torch.Tensor
    computed: torch.Tensor
    reciprocal: model.Reciprocal
    demo_reciprocal: model.Reciprocal
    matrix_error: float
    conditional_error: float
    inverse_error: float
    relative_error: float
    inverse_resources: ResourceEstimate
    mock_resources: ResourceEstimate
    conditional_resources: ResourceEstimate
    costs: torch.Tensor
    mock_probabilities: torch.Tensor
    mock_errors: tuple[float, ...]
    configurations: torch.Tensor


def verify_conditional(heat: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[float, ResourceEstimate]:
    circuit = quantum.conditional_thermal_encoding()
    dimension = 1 << circuit.n_qubits
    initial = torch.zeros(model.CONFIGURATIONS, dimension, dtype=model.COMPLEX)
    for word in range(model.CONFIGURATIONS):
        initial[word, word * 128 : word * 128 + 4] = heat
    execution = fq.Circuit.from_ir(
        circuit.to_ir(), dtype=model.COMPLEX, inputs=initial, bsz=model.CONFIGURATIONS
    )
    states: torch.Tensor = execution.state().reshape(
        model.CONFIGURATIONS, model.CONFIGURATIONS, 128
    )
    values = torch.arange(model.CONFIGURATIONS)
    diagonal = states[values, values]
    reference = torch.stack(
        [
            model.build_matrix(word).to(model.COMPLEX) @ heat / model.alpha()
            for word in range(model.CONFIGURATIONS)
        ]
    )
    maximum = float((diagonal[:, :4] - reference).abs().max())
    leakage = float((states.abs().square().sum() - diagonal.abs().square().sum()).abs())
    if maximum > 1e-10 or leakage > 1e-10:
        raise ValueError(
            "The coherent design register or its conditioned thermal projection changed"
        )
    return maximum, estimate_resources(circuit)


def qae_reference(cost: float) -> torch.Tensor:
    """One explicit controlled Grover step and inverse one-bit Fourier transform."""
    angle = math.asin(cost)
    b = math.cos(angle)
    initial = torch.tensor((b, cost), dtype=model.REAL)
    c, s = math.cos(2 * angle), math.sin(2 * angle)
    rotate = torch.tensor(((c, -s), (s, c)), dtype=model.REAL)
    rotated = rotate @ initial
    vector = torch.cat((initial + rotated, initial - rotated)) / 2
    normalized: torch.Tensor = vector / vector.norm()
    return normalized.to(model.COMPLEX)


def check_qae(costs: torch.Tensor) -> None:
    for value in costs:
        cost = float(value)
        actual = quantum.qae_state(cost)
        expected = qae_reference(cost)
        torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, atol=1e-10, rtol=0)


def preparation_reference(amplitudes: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    magnitudes = amplitudes.abs().reshape(2, 2)
    first, second = (float(row.norm()) for row in magnitudes)
    start = torch.tensor(((first, -second), (second, first)), dtype=model.COMPLEX)
    controlled = torch.zeros(4, 4, dtype=model.COMPLEX)
    for branch, row in enumerate(magnitudes):
        norm = float(row.norm())
        c, s = (float(row[0]) / norm, float(row[1]) / norm) if norm else (1.0, 0.0)
        part = slice(2 * branch, 2 * (branch + 1))
        controlled[part, part] = torch.tensor(((c, -s), (s, c)), dtype=model.COMPLEX)
    result: torch.Tensor = (1j * amplitudes.angle()).exp()[:, None] * (
        controlled @ torch.kron(start, torch.eye(2, dtype=model.COMPLEX))
    )
    return result


def mock_state(costs: torch.Tensor, gamma: float, beta: float) -> torch.Tensor:
    states = torch.empty(model.CONFIGURATIONS, 4, dtype=model.COMPLEX)
    diagonal = torch.ones(4, dtype=model.COMPLEX)
    diagonal[2:] = torch.exp(
        torch.tensor(1j * quantum.QAE_PHASE_WEIGHT * gamma, dtype=model.COMPLEX)
    )
    for index, value in enumerate(costs):
        vector = quantum.qae_state(float(value))
        states[index] = preparation_reference(vector).mH @ (diagonal * vector) / 8
    c, s = math.cos(beta), 1j * math.sin(beta)
    rotation = torch.tensor(((c, s), (s, c)), dtype=model.COMPLEX)
    mixer = rotation
    for _ in range(1, len(model.EDGES)):
        mixer = torch.kron(mixer, rotation)
    mixed: torch.Tensor = mixer @ states
    return mixed.flatten()


def run() -> Result:
    matrix = model.build_matrix()
    rhs = torch.tensor(model.HEAT, dtype=model.REAL)
    signal = quantum.unitary(quantum.thermal_encoding())
    matrix_error = float((signal[:4, :4] * model.alpha() - matrix).abs().max())
    if matrix_error > 1e-10:
        raise ValueError("The encoded block and independent thermal matrix disagree")
    conditional_error, conditional_resources = verify_conditional(
        (rhs / rhs.norm()).to(model.COMPLEX)
    )
    reciprocal = model.inverse_target(1 / (model.alpha() * model.R_ENV), 11)
    demo = model.inverse_target(1 / 3, 11, target_scale=0.3)
    grid = torch.linspace(1 / 3, 1, 1025, dtype=model.REAL)
    if float((response(grid, demo.fit.phases) - 0.3 / grid).abs().max()) >= 0.1:
        raise ValueError(
            "The original demonstration reciprocal interval was not reached"
        )
    circuit = quantum.inverse_circuit(reciprocal)
    projected: torch.Tensor = -circuit.state().flatten()[:4]
    independent = model.spectral_solution(matrix, reciprocal, rhs / rhs.norm())
    inverse_error = float((projected - independent).abs().max())
    computed = projected.real * rhs.norm() / (model.alpha() * reciprocal.scale)
    configurations = model.physical_solutions()
    reference = configurations[-1]
    relative_error = float((computed - reference).norm() / reference.norm())
    if inverse_error > 1e-10 or relative_error >= 0.04:
        raise ValueError("The original-sized degree-11 thermal solution failed")

    costs = model.load_demo_costs()
    check_qae(costs)
    template = quantum.mock_qaoa(costs)
    rows = []
    probabilities = []
    for gamma, beta in BINDINGS:
        state: torch.Tensor = (
            template.bind_parameters({"gamma": gamma, "beta": beta}).state().flatten()
        )
        expected = mock_state(costs, gamma, beta)
        error = float((state - expected).abs().max())
        if error > 1e-10:
            raise ValueError("The complete mocked thermal QAOA state disagrees")
        rows.append(error)
        probabilities.append(
            state.reshape(model.CONFIGURATIONS, 4).abs().square().sum(dim=1)
        )
    if template.parameter_names != ("beta", "gamma"):
        raise ValueError("The model must remain symbolic across both executions")
    return Result(
        matrix,
        reference,
        computed,
        reciprocal,
        demo,
        matrix_error,
        conditional_error,
        inverse_error,
        relative_error,
        estimate_resources(circuit),
        estimate_resources(template),
        conditional_resources,
        costs,
        torch.stack(probabilities),
        tuple(rows),
        configurations,
    )

"""Compose the thermal block encoding and the original mock-QAE template."""

import math

import torch

import flagquantum as fq
from examples.synthesis.applications.cfd.qls_for_hybrid_solvers.verify_block_encoding.overview.quantum import (
    preparation,
)

from .model import (
    COMPLEX,
    CONFIGURATIONS,
    EDGES,
    HEAT,
    REAL,
    Reciprocal,
    alpha,
    weights,
)

THERMAL_DATA = 2
THERMAL_BLOCK = 5
THERMAL_WIDTH = 7
FULL_QAE_BITS = 5
MOCK_QAE_BITS = 1
QAE_PHASE_WEIGHT = math.sin(math.pi / (1 << FULL_QAE_BITS))
DESIGN_BITS = len(EDGES)


def pair_block(i: int, j: int, *, enabled: bool) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Encode the thermal pair on flag, pair-ancilla and two data bits."""
    condition = i ^ j
    transform = torch.zeros(16, 16, dtype=COMPLEX)
    if not enabled:
        for word in range(16):
            transform[word ^ 8, word] = 1
        return transform
    for word in range(16):
        point = word & 3
        linked = point in (i, j)
        rotate = (word & 4) != 0
        target = word ^ (0 if linked else 8)
        if rotate:
            target ^= condition
        transform[target, word] = -1 if rotate else 1
    h = torch.tensor(((1, 1), (1, -1)), dtype=COMPLEX) / math.sqrt(2)
    lift = torch.kron(
        torch.eye(2, dtype=COMPLEX), torch.kron(h, torch.eye(4, dtype=COMPLEX))
    )
    return lift @ transform @ lift


def thermal_encoding(word: int = 63) -> fq.Circuit:
    """Use the source's six pair terms, ambient identity and unused selector."""
    prep = preparation((torch.tensor(weights(), dtype=REAL) / (alpha() / 2)).sqrt())
    selection = torch.eye(128, dtype=COMPLEX)
    for index, (i, j) in enumerate(EDGES):
        portion = slice(16 * index, 16 * (index + 1))
        selected = bool(word & (1 << (DESIGN_BITS - 1 - index)))
        selection[portion, portion] = pair_block(i, j, enabled=selected)
    circuit = fq.Circuit(THERMAL_WIDTH, dtype=COMPLEX).compose(prep, qubits=(0, 1, 2))
    circuit.any(*range(THERMAL_WIDTH), matrix=selection)
    return circuit.compose(prep.adjoint(), qubits=(0, 1, 2))


def conditional_thermal_encoding() -> fq.Circuit:
    """Define the original conditional thermal oracle for every six-bit design."""
    prep = preparation((torch.tensor(weights(), dtype=REAL) / (alpha() / 2)).sqrt())
    selectors = (6, 7, 8)
    thermal_wires = tuple(range(6, 13))
    circuit = fq.Circuit(13, dtype=COMPLEX).compose(prep, qubits=selectors)
    for index, (i, j) in enumerate(EDGES):
        operator = torch.eye(256, dtype=COMPLEX)
        for active in (False, True):
            offset = 128 * int(active) + 16 * index
            span = slice(offset, offset + 16)
            operator[span, span] = pair_block(i, j, enabled=active)
        circuit.any(index, *thermal_wires, matrix=operator)
    return circuit.compose(prep.adjoint(), qubits=selectors)


def inverse_circuit(reciprocal: Reciprocal) -> fq.Circuit:
    """Prepare the signed heat vector and apply all eleven encoded inverse calls."""
    block = thermal_encoding()
    inverse = block.adjoint()
    angles = reciprocal.fit.phases - math.pi / 2
    angles[0] += math.pi / 4
    angles[-1] += math.pi / 4
    if angles.numel() != 12:
        raise ValueError("Expected the source degree-11 reciprocal")
    heat = torch.tensor(HEAT, dtype=REAL)
    circuit = (
        fq.Circuit(8, dtype=COMPLEX)
        .compose(preparation(heat / heat.norm()), qubits=(6, 7))
        .h(0)
    )
    words = torch.arange(64)
    signs = 2 * (((words & 31) == 0) == (words >> 5 == 0)).to(REAL) - 1
    for index, angle in enumerate(angles):
        circuit.any(*range(6), matrix=torch.diag((1j * angle * signs).exp()))
        if index != angles.numel() - 1:
            circuit.compose(
                inverse if index % 2 == 0 else block, qubits=tuple(range(1, 8))
            )
    return circuit.h(0)


def qae_state(cost: float) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Form the source's two signed eigenphase branches for one phase bit."""
    phase = math.asin(cost)
    k = torch.arange(2, dtype=REAL)
    counter = torch.arange(2, dtype=REAL)[:, None]
    positive = (1j * k * (2 * phase - math.pi * counter)).exp().mean(dim=1)
    negative = (1j * k * (-2 * phase - math.pi * counter)).exp().mean(dim=1)
    cp = (math.sin(phase) - 1j * math.cos(phase)) / math.sqrt(2)
    cm = (math.sin(phase) + 1j * math.cos(phase)) / math.sqrt(2)
    accepted = (cp * positive + cm * negative) / math.sqrt(2)
    rejected = 1j * (cp * positive - cm * negative) / math.sqrt(2)
    amplitudes = torch.stack((rejected, accepted), dim=1).flatten()
    rounded = torch.complex(
        amplitudes.real.round(decimals=10), amplitudes.imag.round(decimals=10)
    )
    normalized: torch.Tensor = rounded / rounded.norm()
    return normalized


def complex_preparation(amplitudes: torch.Tensor) -> fq.Circuit:
    """Prepare passed complex amplitudes with real magnitude rotations and phases."""
    real = preparation(amplitudes.abs())
    circuit = fq.Circuit(2, dtype=COMPLEX).compose(real)
    return circuit.any(0, 1, matrix=torch.diag((1j * amplitudes.angle()).exp()))


def unitary(circuit: fq.Circuit) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Read a small local unitary by executing each basis column."""
    dimension = 1 << circuit.n_qubits
    if dimension > 128:
        raise ValueError("The verification batch is limited to seven wires")
    batched = fq.Circuit.from_ir(
        circuit.to_ir(),
        dtype=COMPLEX,
        bsz=dimension,
        inputs=torch.eye(dimension, dtype=COMPLEX),
    )
    state: torch.Tensor = batched.state().reshape(dimension, dimension)
    return state.T.contiguous()


def mock_qaoa(costs: torch.Tensor) -> fq.Circuit:
    """Build and reuse the same symbolic one-layer eight-qubit mock model."""
    selection = torch.zeros((256, 256), dtype=COMPLEX)
    for index in range(CONFIGURATIONS):
        prep = complex_preparation(qae_state(float(costs[index])))
        span = slice(4 * index, 4 * (index + 1))
        selection[span, span] = unitary(prep)
    wires = tuple(range(8))
    circuit = fq.Circuit(8, dtype=COMPLEX)
    for wire in range(DESIGN_BITS):
        circuit.h(wire)
    circuit.any(*wires, matrix=selection)
    circuit.phase(6, theta=QAE_PHASE_WEIGHT * fq.Parameter("gamma"))
    circuit.any(*wires, matrix=selection.mH)
    beta = fq.Parameter("beta")
    for wire in range(DESIGN_BITS):
        circuit.rx(wire, theta=-2 * beta)
    return circuit

"""Fresh four-node thermal systems and reciprocal polynomial responses."""

import json
import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import torch

from examples.synthesis.applications.cfd.qls_for_hybrid_solvers.qls_qsvt.overview.phases import (
    PhaseFit,
    fit,
    response,
)

REAL = torch.float64
COMPLEX = torch.complex128
AMBIENT = 293
R_ENV = 0.001
HEAT = (2000.0, 4000.0, -200.0, -2000.0)
EDGES = ((0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 3), (1, 2), (1, 3), (2, 3))
RESISTANCES = (0.005, 0.006, 0.006, 0.007, 0.007, 0.008)
CONFIGURATIONS = 64
TABLE = Path(__file__).parent / "data" / "costs.json"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Reciprocal:
    coefficients: torch.Tensor
    scale: float
    fit: PhaseFit
    minimum: float


def build_matrix(word: int = 63) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Regenerate one thermal matrix by its six conductance toggles."""
    if not 0 <= word < CONFIGURATIONS:
        raise ValueError("Expected a six-bit cooling configuration")
    matrix = torch.eye(4, dtype=REAL) / R_ENV
    for index, ((i, j), resistance) in enumerate(zip(EDGES, RESISTANCES, strict=True)):
        if (word >> (len(EDGES) - 1 - index)) & 1:
            value = 1 / resistance
            matrix[i, i] += value
            matrix[j, j] += value
            matrix[i, j] -= value
            matrix[j, i] -= value
    return matrix


def weights() -> tuple[float, ...]:
    return (*tuple(1 / value for value in RESISTANCES), 1 / (2 * R_ENV), 0.0)


def alpha() -> float:
    return 2 * math.fsum(weights())


def inverse_target(
    minimum: float, degree: int, *, target_scale: float | None = None
) -> Reciprocal:
    """Fit the odd mapped Chebyshev reciprocal at the source degree."""
    order = (degree + 1) // 2
    shift = 1 + minimum**2
    span = 1 - minimum**2
    x = (math.pi * (torch.arange(degree + 1, dtype=REAL) + 0.5) / (degree + 1)).cos()

    def recurrence(mapped: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        previous, value = torch.ones_like(mapped), mapped
        for _ in range(1, order):
            previous, value = value, 2 * mapped * value - previous
        return value

    normalizer = recurrence(torch.tensor(-shift / span, dtype=REAL))
    y = (1 - recurrence((2 * x.square() - shift) / span) / normalizer) / x
    degrees = torch.arange(1, degree + 1, 2, dtype=REAL)
    coefficients = (2 / x.numel()) * torch.cos(torch.acos(x)[:, None] * degrees).T @ y
    dense = torch.linspace(0, math.pi, 16385, dtype=REAL)
    max_p = float((torch.cos(dense[:, None] * degrees) @ coefficients).abs().max())
    amplitude_scale = 0.95 / max_p if target_scale is None else target_scale
    if amplitude_scale * max_p >= 1:
        raise ValueError("The scaled reciprocal must remain bounded")
    coefficients *= amplitude_scale
    return Reciprocal(coefficients, amplitude_scale, fit(coefficients), minimum)


def physical_solutions() -> torch.Tensor:
    """Regenerate all 64 classical candidate systems from their conductances."""
    matrices = torch.stack([build_matrix(word) for word in range(CONFIGURATIONS)])
    heat = torch.tensor(HEAT, dtype=REAL).expand(CONFIGURATIONS, -1)
    currents: torch.Tensor = torch.linalg.solve(matrices, heat)
    return currents


def load_demo_costs(path: Path = TABLE) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Read the source's separate one-phase-bit mock QAE experiment input."""
    loaded = json.loads(path.read_text())["costs"]
    tensor = torch.as_tensor(loaded, dtype=REAL)
    if tensor.shape != (CONFIGURATIONS,) or not bool(torch.isfinite(tensor).all()):
        raise ValueError("Expected 64 finite mock-QAE data inputs")
    if bool(((tensor < 0) | (tensor > 1)).any()):
        raise ValueError("Demo costs must lie in [0,1]")
    return tensor


def spectral_solution(
    matrix: torch.Tensor, reciprocal: Reciprocal, rhs: torch.Tensor
) -> torch.Tensor:
    values, directions = torch.linalg.eigh(matrix / alpha())
    bounded = response(values, reciprocal.fit.phases)
    result: torch.Tensor = directions @ (bounded * (directions.T @ rhs))
    return result

"""Fit odd symmetric QSP phases to a fresh Chebyshev series."""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

DTYPE = torch.float64
CTYPE = torch.complex128


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PhaseFit:
    phases: torch.Tensor
    residual: float
    iterations: int


def signal(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    w = x.to(CTYPE)
    y = 1j * (1 - x.square()).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
    return torch.stack((w, y, y, w), dim=-1).reshape(-1, 2, 2)


def values_and_derivative(
    w: torch.Tensor, half: torch.Tensor
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    rotation = torch.diag_embed(
        torch.stack(((1j * half).exp(), (-1j * half).exp()), dim=-1)
    )
    product = [rotation[j] @ w for j in range(half.numel())]
    product[-1] = rotation[-1].expand(w.size(0), -1, -1)
    identity = torch.eye(2, dtype=CTYPE).expand(w.size(0), -1, -1)
    prefix = [identity]
    for factor in product:
        prefix.append(prefix[-1] @ factor)
    left = prefix[-1]
    right = w @ left.transpose(-1, -2)
    result = (left @ right)[:, 0, 0].imag
    deriv = []
    suffix = right
    generator = torch.diag(torch.tensor([1j, -1j], dtype=CTYPE))
    for j in range(half.numel() - 1, -1, -1):
        suffix = product[j] @ suffix
        deriv.append(2 * (prefix[j] @ generator @ suffix)[:, 0, 0].imag)
    return result, torch.stack(list(reversed(deriv)), dim=1)


def response(x: torch.Tensor, angles: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    w = signal(x)
    phases = torch.diag_embed(
        torch.stack(((1j * angles).exp(), (-1j * angles).exp()), dim=-1)
    )
    out = phases[0]
    for rotation in phases[1:]:
        out = out @ w @ rotation
    value: torch.Tensor = out[:, 0, 0].imag
    return value


def fit(coefficients: torch.Tensor) -> PhaseFit:
    extent = coefficients.numel()
    nodes = math.pi * (torch.arange(extent, dtype=DTYPE) + 0.5) / (2 * extent)
    orders = torch.arange(1, 2 * extent, 2, dtype=DTYPE)
    w = signal(torch.cos(nodes))
    target = torch.cos(nodes[:, None] * orders) @ coefficients
    theta = torch.zeros_like(orders)
    iteration = 0
    while iteration < 12:
        samples, jacobian = values_and_derivative(w, theta)
        residual = target - samples
        if float(residual.abs().max()) < 1e-12:
            break
        theta += torch.linalg.solve(jacobian, residual)
        iteration += 1
    physical = torch.cat((theta, theta.flip((0,))))
    angles = torch.linspace(0, math.pi, 4097, dtype=DTYPE)
    x = angles.cos()
    error = float(
        (response(x, physical) - torch.cos(angles[:, None] * orders) @ coefficients)
        .abs()
        .max()
    )
    if error >= 1e-10:
        raise ValueError("The fresh QSP sequence must verify on the dense grid")
    return PhaseFit(physical, error, iteration)

"""Native PREPARE with explicit Pauli and banded SELECT blocks."""

import cmath

import torch

import flagquantum as fq
from flagquantum import synth
from flagquantum.algorithms.primitives.multiplexers.select_pauli_lcu import (
    SelectPauliLCU,
)
from flagquantum.synth import Output, QArray, QBit, prepare_amplitudes, qfunc

from .model import CTYPE, bands, pauli_expansion


@qfunc
def prepare(amplitudes: list[float], q: Output[QArray[QBit]]) -> None:
    prepare_amplitudes(amplitudes, 0, q)


def preparation(values: torch.Tensor) -> fq.Circuit:
    data = tuple(float(value) for value in values)
    n = len(data).bit_length() - 1
    program = synth.synthesize(
        prepare, classical_inputs={"amplitudes": data}, max_qubits=n, max_workspace=0
    )
    assert program.registers["q"] == tuple(range(n))
    return fq.Circuit.from_ir(program.circuit, dtype=CTYPE)


def pauli_encoding(matrix: torch.Tensor, rhs: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[fq.Circuit, float]:
    coefficients = pauli_expansion(matrix)
    size = 32
    weights = [weight for _, weight in coefficients]
    alpha = sum(abs(weight) for weight in weights)
    amps = torch.zeros(size, dtype=torch.float64)
    amps[: len(weights)] = torch.tensor(
        [(abs(w) / alpha) ** 0.5 for w in weights], dtype=torch.float64
    )
    prep = preparation(amps)
    circuit = fq.Circuit(8, dtype=CTYPE)
    selectors = tuple(range(5))
    data = (5, 6, 7)
    circuit.compose(prep, qubits=selectors).compose(preparation(rhs), qubits=data)
    circuit.append(
        SelectPauliLCU(5, 3, tuple(label for label, _ in coefficients)).make_on(
            selection=selectors, target=data
        )
    )
    phases = torch.tensor(
        [cmath.exp(1j * cmath.phase(w)) for w in weights] + [1] * (size - len(weights)),
        dtype=CTYPE,
    )
    circuit.any(*selectors, matrix=torch.diag(phases))
    circuit.compose(prep.adjoint(), qubits=selectors)
    return circuit, alpha


def banded_encoding(
    matrix: torch.Tensor, rhs: torch.Tensor
) -> tuple[fq.Circuit, float]:
    offsets = bands(matrix)
    if offsets != (-1, 0, 1) or bool(matrix.imag.any()):
        raise ValueError(
            "this banded encoding requires the real source tridiagonal profile"
        )
    widths = [float(matrix.diagonal(offset).abs().max()) for offset in offsets]
    alpha = sum(widths)
    weights = preparation(
        torch.tensor([(w / alpha) ** 0.5 for w in widths] + [0], dtype=torch.float64)
    )
    matrix_parts = []
    for offset, scale in zip(offsets, widths, strict=True):
        diagonal = torch.zeros(8, dtype=torch.float64)
        shift = torch.zeros((8, 8), dtype=CTYPE)
        for col in range(8):
            row = col - offset
            if 0 <= row < 8:
                diagonal[col] = matrix[row, col].real / scale
            shift[row % 8, col] = 1
        d = torch.diag(diagonal).to(CTYPE)
        complement = torch.diag((1 - diagonal.square()).clamp_min(0).sqrt()).to(CTYPE)
        dilated = torch.cat(
            (torch.cat((d, complement), 1), torch.cat((complement, -d), 1)), 0
        )
        both = torch.zeros((16, 16), dtype=CTYPE)
        both[:8, :8] = both[8:, 8:] = shift
        matrix_parts.append(both @ dilated)
    matrix_parts.append(torch.eye(16, dtype=CTYPE))
    select = torch.zeros((64, 64), dtype=CTYPE)
    for index, part in enumerate(matrix_parts):
        group = slice(16 * index, 16 * (index + 1))
        select[group, group] = part
    torch.testing.assert_close(
        select.mH @ select, torch.eye(64, dtype=CTYPE), atol=1e-12, rtol=0
    )
    circuit = (
        fq.Circuit(6, dtype=CTYPE)
        .compose(weights, qubits=(0, 1))
        .compose(preparation(rhs), qubits=(3, 4, 5))
    )
    circuit.any(*range(6), matrix=select)
    circuit.compose(weights.adjoint(), qubits=(0, 1))
    return circuit, alpha
